function.name: impl_from_IWICColorTransform
function.description: This function retrieves the containing record of the IWICColorTransform interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICColorTransform interface.

function.return_type: ColorTransform*; pointer to the containing record of the IWICColorTransform interface.

function.name: ColorTransform_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface identifier (IID) matches any of the known IIDs (IUnknown, IWICBitmapSource, IWICColorTransform). If it does, it assigns the address of the IWICColorTransform interface to the provided pointer and increases the reference count. If it doesn't, it sets the pointer to NULL and returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IWICColorTransform interface

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Interface identifier to be checked

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer that receives the interface pointer requested in iid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation was successful, E_INVALIDARG if ppv is NULL, and E_NOINTERFACE if the provided iid does not match any of the known IIDs

function.name: ColorTransform_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the ColorTransform object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an instance of IWICColorTransform interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after increment.

function.name: ColorTransform_Release
function.description: This function releases the color transform object and decreases its reference count. If the reference count is zero, it releases the bitmap source and frees the memory allocated to the object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the color transform interface object that is to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, which represents the updated reference count of the color transform object after it has been decremented.

function.name: ColorTransform_GetSize
function.description: This function retrieves the size of the color transform object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the color transform interface.

parameters.name: puiWidth
parameters.description: Pointer to store the width of the color transform object.

parameters.name: puiHeight
parameters.description: Pointer to store the height of the color transform object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: ColorTransform_GetPixelFormat
function.description: This function retrieves the pixel format of the color transform.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICColorTransform interface

parameters.name: pPixelFormat
parameters.description: Pointer to a WICPixelFormatGUID structure that receives the pixel format of the color transform

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code

function.name: ColorTransform_GetResolution
function.description: This function retrieves the resolution of the color transform object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the color transform interface.

parameters.name: pDpiX
parameters.description: Pointer to store the horizontal resolution.

parameters.name: pDpiY
parameters.description: Pointer to store the vertical resolution.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, the function returns S_OK.

function.name: ColorTransform_CopyPalette
function.description: This function copies the color palette from the destination bitmap source to the provided IWICPalette object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICColorTransform interface

parameters.name: pIPalette
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICPalette interface where the color palette will be copied

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: ColorTransform_CopyPixels
function.description: This function is used to copy pixels from a source to a destination buffer using a color transform.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the color transform interface

parameters.name: prc
parameters.description: Pointer to the rectangle structure that specifies the portion of the bitmap to copy

parameters.name: cbStride
parameters.description: Specifies the stride, or pitch, of the bitmap

parameters.name: cbBufferSize
parameters.description: Specifies the size of the buffer

parameters.name: pbBuffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer that receives the bitmap data

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an HRESULT error code

function.name: ColorTransform_Initialize
function.description: This function initializes a color transformation, converting a bitmap source to a specified pixel format, ignoring color contexts.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the color transform object

parameters.name: pIBitmapSource
parameters.description: Pointer to the source bitmap to be transformed

parameters.name: pIContextSource
parameters.description: Pointer to the source color context, currently ignored

parameters.name: pIContextDest
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination color context, currently ignored

parameters.name: pixelFmtDest
parameters.description: Reference to the GUID of the destination pixel format

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, S_OK if successful, error code otherwise

function.name: ColorTransform_Create
function.description: This function creates a color transform object and initializes its properties.

parameters.name: colortransform
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to an IWICColorTransform interface. This parameter receives the interface pointer of the new color transform object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the function fails, it returns an error code, such as E_INVALIDARG (if the colortransform parameter is NULL) or E_OUTOFMEMORY (if the function cannot allocate enough memory).
